title: cyclamen hederifolium subsp. romanum
intro: Cyclamen hederifolium subsp. romanum, commonly known as Roman ivy-leaved cyclamen, is a sub-species of the Cyclamen hederifolium plant, belonging to the primrose family (Primulaceae). This plant is known for its heart-shaped leaves and delicate white or pink flowers, which are often used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Cyclamen hederifolium subsp. romanum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties.
